_comment: Words that split one utterance into item phrases, and filler words the parser drops.
_fillerComment: Do NOT add number words here: ఒక is one, వెయ్యి is a thousand (V1: 'వెయ్యి రూపాయల బియ్యం' lost its amount when it was a filler). VD: Telangana జర/zara (please), Hyderabadi దేదో/చాహియే, Rayalaseema/coastal కావలె/కావల్ల, 'put it' ఏసెయ్/వేసెయ్. NOT bare 'వెయ్యి' (put / thousand): it stays a number; after a unit it reads as a stray number and the line ASKS (VD-2).
_genericComment: Category words, not products: an item whose own name/alias IS one of these words can never be auto-added by voice — the matcher caps it at ask-only (VOICE-6, FIX-1 2026-10-20). 'నూనె' alone must always ask which oil. VD (2026-10-22): also the code-mixed category words (ఆయిల్/oil/tel, దాల్/dal, సోప్/sabun, రవ్వ — Bombay vs idli, మిర్చి — green vs powder, మసాలా) and every pharmacy symptom/class phrase (జ్వరం మాత్రలు, బీపీ మాత్ర, గ్యాస్ మాత్ర, మాత్ర, సిరప్, మందు, paracetamol — 500 vs 650): a symptom names a shelf, never one medicine.
_currencyComment: A number followed by a currency word means 'this many rupees worth' (పది రూపాయల ఉల్లిపాయలు = ₹10 of onions).
